evidence: The Ta-N ﬁlm deposition was carried out on SiO 2 ~100 nm!/Si wafers at a deposition temperature of 260°C and a deposition pressure of 133 Pa in a cold-walled reactor using ~NEt2!3Ta 5 NBut @tertbutylimidotris~diethylamido!tantalum, TBTDET# as a precursor of Ta. One deposition cycle consists of an exposure to a metallorganic precursor of TBTDET, a purge period with argon ~Ar!, and an exposure to hydrogen plasma, followed by another purge period with argon. The Ar purge period of 15 s inserted between each reactant gas pulse isolates the reactant gases from each other.
